title.en: Google announces Gemini 4 Argon in a phased trusted-access rollout
title.zhHans: Google 宣布 Gemini 4 Argon，并通过可信访问计划分阶段开放

searchSummary.en: Google announced Gemini 4 Argon and began a phased rollout to trusted cyber defenders through the Fairwind Program before broader developer and consumer availability.
searchSummary.zhHans: Google 宣布 Gemini 4 Argon，并先通过 Fairwind Program 向可信网络防御人员分阶段开放，再计划扩大至开发者与消费者。

summary.en: Google announced Gemini 4 Argon and began a phased rollout to trusted cyber defenders through the Fairwind Program before broader developer and consumer availability.
summary.zhHans: Google 宣布 Gemini 4 Argon，并先通过 Fairwind Program 向可信网络防御人员分阶段开放，再计划扩大至开发者与消费者。

narrative.en: Argon is a limited-access frontier-model launch rather than general availability. Independent reporting confirms the announcement and early benchmark comparisons, but broad production use and the company’s internal productivity claims were not independently established.
narrative.zhHans: Argon 属于有限访问的前沿模型发布，而非全面可用。独立报道确认了公告和早期跑分比较，但广泛生产使用及公司披露的内部生产力提升尚未得到独立证明。

text.en: Google announced Gemini 4 Argon with initial access through the Fairwind Program.
text.zhHans: Google 宣布 Gemini 4 Argon，首批通过 Fairwind Program 提供访问。

text.en: Access remained phased and restricted; vendor benchmark and internal-use claims were not independently verified.
text.zhHans: 访问仍处于分阶段受限状态；厂商跑分与内部使用成效未得到独立验证。
